answer: Each identity registers a reef copper lot of at least 50 units and locks a 70-credit bond. Its origin hash goes to the reef ledger, publishing a lot list each pulse. Auditors check the 50-unit minimum and no origin hash appears under two keys in one pulse; a split copper lot, sub-minimum lot, or double registration burns the bonds. The kth registration costs 20+4(k-1), so the 1,000th costs 4,016 and 1,000 fakes pay 2,018,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-lot ring fails because one origin hash cannot back two identities. An honest miner pays 20 once, then recovers the bond.
